question: Which authority launched a scheme in Greater Noida in June 2025 to promote medical device manufacturing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Government of UP**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **Government of Uttar Pradesh** (**UP**) launched a major scheme in **June 2025** specifically designed to accelerate the growth of **medical device manufacturing** in the **Greater Noida** region. 
• The initiative is strategically focused on the **Medical Device Park** being developed by the **Yamuna Expressway Industrial Development Authority** (**YEIDA**) in **Sector 28**. 
• This scheme aims to provide a robust ecosystem for the production of critical medical equipment, such as **imaging systems**, **cardiac stents**, and **cancer care equipment**, reducing the country's heavy reliance on imports. 
• Under the leadership of the **Chief Minister**, the **Government of UP** has introduced a dedicated **incentive framework** that includes **capital subsidies**, **interest subvention**, and **reimbursements** on SGST</s
